premises.text: Chronic unpredictable blackouts force households and businesses into costly backup generation and daily disruption
premises.evidence_span: it costs four times the amount to run a backup generator than it costs to get power from the grid

premises.text: Low-cost Android phones plus proprietary hardware become community power sensors that push outage/restore alerts (app or SMS) and let users report downed lines
premises.evidence_span: we take low-cost Android phones, just like this, and we turn them into power sensors

premises.text: Primary customers are power companies that communicate with customers on the platform; roadmap includes in-app bill pay/receipt and a data play
